answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond that can back only one identity at a time, verified on-chain. Creating ten fake identities means locking ten separate bonds, so a Sybil attacker pays ten times the capital while an honest agent pays once. Like a ridge path narrowing to a single gate, a shale layer cracking under copied weight, and a saffron harvest where each flower yields one thread, the bond makes duplication expensive rather than free.
